note: Verbatim recommendation text for each step (ERC First Aid).

excerpts.section: ERC 2025 First Aid, Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Control of life-threatening bleeding
excerpts.text: Apply firm direct manual pressure to the bleeding injury

excerpts.section: ERC 2025 First Aid, Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Control of life-threatening bleeding
excerpts.text: Apply a standard or haemostatic dressing directly into the bleeding injury and then apply firm direct manual pressure on top of the dressing.

excerpts.section: ERC 2025 First Aid, Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Control of life-threatening bleeding
excerpts.text: Once bleeding is under control, apply a pressure dressing.

excerpts.section: ERC 2025 First Aid, Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Control of life-threatening bleeding, tourniquet
excerpts.text: Apply a tourniquet as soon as possible for life-threatening extremity bleeding that is not controlled by direct manual pressure.

excerpts.section: ERC 2025 First Aid, Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Control of life-threatening bleeding, tourniquet
excerpts.text: Write the time of application on the tourniquet.
